g.title: HeatStroke
g.text: Heat Stroke — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology map
exertional (EHS) and classic / non-exertional (NEHS) heat stroke as one heat-balance equation read in three regimes
regime 1 COMPENSABLE (a fixed point exists) → regime 2 UNCOMPENSABLE (no fixed point: a clock) → regime 3 COMMITTED (a latched bistable switch)

g.title: cluster_env
g.text: 1. Environmental heat load and metabolic heat production
the numerator: everything that puts joules into the body

g.title: cluster_eff
g.text: 2. Heat loss pathways and the thermoregulatory effectors
the denominator: everything that takes joules out — and its ceiling

g.title: cluster_therm
g.text: 3. Thermal compartments and the loss of the fixed point
three nodes, one bifurcation: this is where heat stroke actually begins

g.title: cluster_dose
g.text: 4. Thermal dose — the variable the patient actually pays
Sapareto–Dewey CEM43: temperature and time are NOT exchangeable 1:1

g.title: cluster_cv
g.text: 5. Cardiovascular strain and the splanchnic steal
the same vasodilation that sheds heat starves the gut

g.title: cluster_gut
g.text: the same event opens the door and closes the exit

g.title: cluster_immune
g.text: 7. Innate immune cascade and the HMGB1 COMMITMENT SWITCH
a saddle-node bistability: OFF = 0, unstable = 10.9, ON = 50.3 ng/mL

g.title: cluster_coag
g.text: 8. Endothelial injury, glycocalyx shedding and DIC
heat stroke coagulopathy is consumption, and it is scored as an output

g.title: cluster_organ
g.text: 9. Organ injury — the phenotype that outlives the fever
liver and kidney peak on days 2–4, long after the temperature is normal

g.title: cluster_cool
g.text: 10. Cooling: modality is a POTENCY, delay is an EXPOSURE TIME
each modality is one lumped conductance UA (W/K) fitted to its published cooling rate

g.title: cluster_drug
g.text: 11. Pharmacology — each agent acts on exactly one regime
antipyretics act on a set-point that is not the binding constraint; only rTM touches the switch

g.title: cluster_end
g.text: 12. Clinical endpoints and scores (all computed as OUTPUTS)

g.title: cluster_two
g.text: The two heat strokes are one equation with two numerators

g.title: REG1
g.text: T_c plateaus • this is heat STRAIN

g.title: SAME
g.text: The warning a thermometer gives you
is inversely proportional to the imbalance.

g.title: DEFN
g.text: TWO thresholds on ONE dose axis

g.title: SETPT
g.text: fever moves T_set and the body defends it;
heat stroke leaves T_set at 37 with the

g.title: LEG
g.text: computed result, not a state variable
